mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM shops s, `shops_user_role` r WHERE s.`shop_id` = r.`shop_id` AND r.`user_id` = #{userId}

select s.all_money as allMoney, s.cash_money as cashMoney, r.all_user as allUser, o.today_money as todayMoney, m.month_money as monthMoney from shops s left join (select shop_id,count(user_id) as all_user from shops_user_role where shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY shop_id) r on r.`shop_id` = s.`shop_id` left join (select shop_id,ifnull(sum(shop_money),0) as today_money from orders where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 3 and create_time >= CURDATE() and create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY) o on o.`shop_id` = s.`shop_id` left join ( select shop_id,ifnull(sum(shop_money), 0) as month_money from orders where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 3 and create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') and create_time < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) m on m.shop_id = s.shop_id where s.`shop_id` = #{shopId}

select s.all_money as allMoney, s.cash_money as cashMoney, r.all_user as allUser, o.today_money as todayMoney, m.month_money as monthMoney from shops s left join (select shop_id,count(user_id) as all_user from shops_user_role where shop_id = #{shopId} GROUP BY shop_id) r on r.`shop_id` = s.`shop_id` left join (select shop_id,ifnull(sum(pay_money),0) as today_money from orders where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 3 and create_time >= CURDATE() and create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY) o on o.`shop_id` = s.`shop_id` left join ( select shop_id,ifnull(sum(pay_money), 0) as month_money from orders where shop_id = #{shopId} and order_status = 3 and create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') and create_time < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') + INTERVAL 1 MONTH ) m on m.shop_id = s.shop_id where s.`shop_id` = #{shopId}

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS pendingVerifyCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 3 THEN 1 END) AS completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN order_status = 4 THEN 1 END) AS refundedCount FROM orders WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
